# Operators Manual limits by engine

<!-- Generated by docs/tools/gen_om_limits.py from engines/*.json — do not edit by hand. -->

These are the limits the app checks every flight against, taken from each engine's Rotax Operators Manual. The same table, for your workspace's engine, is under **Settings → Engine** in the app. How a limit becomes an event — minimum durations, phase suppression, the 30 s merge gap — is explained in [Operators Manual limits and events](../concepts/limits-and-events.md).

## Sources

| Engine | Operators Manual | Rated power | Turbocharged |
|---|---|---|---|
| 916iS | OM-916 i/C24, Edition 0 / Rev. 1, December 2023 | 157 hp / 117 kW at 5,800 rpm | yes |
| 915iS | OM-915 i A / C24, Edition 0 / Rev. 4, September 2022 (Ref. No. OM-915 i A / C24, Part No. 898851) | 139 hp / 104 kW at 5,800 rpm | yes |
| 912iS | OM-912 i Series, Edition 2 / Rev. 2, September 01 2025 | 100 hp / 73.5 kW at 5,800 rpm | no |

## Limits

| Limit | 916iS | 915iS | 912iS | Label |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Idle RPM minimum | ≥ 1,800 rpm | ≥ 1,800 rpm | ≥ 1,400 rpm | CAUTION |
| Takeoff RPM (5-min limit) | ≤ 5,800 rpm | ≤ 5,800 rpm | ≤ 5,800 rpm | WARNING |
| Oil pressure min (>3500 rpm) | ≥ 29 psi | ≥ 29 psi | ≥ 29 psi | WARNING |
| Oil pressure max (>3500 rpm) | ≤ 72.5 psi | ≤ 72.5 psi | ≤ 73 psi | CAUTION |
| Oil pressure max (cold start) | ≤ 101.5 psi | ≤ 101.5 psi | ≤ 102 psi | CAUTION |
| Oil temp minimum (takeoff) | ≥ 122°F | ≥ 122°F | ≥ 122°F | WARNING |
| Oil temp maximum | ≤ 248°F | ≤ 266°F | ≤ 266°F | WARNING |
| Oil temp optimal band (low) | ≥ 194°F | ≥ 194°F | ≥ 194°F | CAUTION |
| Coolant temp maximum | ≤ 248°F | ≤ 248°F | ≤ 248°F | WARNING |
| EGT1 maximum | ≤ 1,742°F | ≤ 1,742°F | ≤ 1,742°F | WARNING |
| EGT2 maximum | ≤ 1,742°F | ≤ 1,742°F | ≤ 1,742°F | WARNING |
| EGT3 maximum | ≤ 1,742°F | ≤ 1,742°F | ≤ 1,742°F | WARNING |
| EGT4 maximum | ≤ 1,742°F | ≤ 1,742°F | ≤ 1,742°F | WARNING |
| Manifold pressure maximum | ≤ 53.15 inHg | ≤ 51.09 inHg | — | WARNING |

## EGT split and takeoff power

| Rule | 916iS | 915iS | 912iS |
|---|---|---|---|
| EGT split (normal fuel flow) | ≤ 392°F above 3 L/h fuel flow | ≤ 392°F above 3 L/h fuel flow | no EGT split limit |
| EGT split (low fuel flow) | ≤ 932°F below 3 L/h | ≤ 932°F below 3 L/h | — |
| Time at takeoff power | ≤ 300 s above 5,500 rpm or 100 % power; close call within 60 s | ≤ 300 s above 5,500 rpm or 100 % power; close call within 60 s | ≤ 300 s above 5,500 rpm or 100 % power; close call within 60 s |

## When each limit is checked

Phase suppression and minimum durations for the 916iS profile. Other engines use the same rules unless noted in the app.

| Limit | Checked |
|---|---|
| Idle RPM minimum | must persist 30 s; engine at or above 1,000 rpm; after first reached this flight |
| Takeoff RPM (5-min limit) | — |
| Oil pressure min (>3500 rpm) | checked only during climb, cruise, descent; never filterable |
| Oil pressure max (>3500 rpm) | — |
| Oil pressure max (cold start) | — |
| Oil temp minimum (takeoff) | checked only during takeoff, climb, cruise |
| Oil temp maximum | — |
| Oil temp optimal band (low) | noted on the card, not an event |
| Coolant temp maximum | — |
| EGT1 maximum | — |
| EGT2 maximum | — |
| EGT3 maximum | — |
| EGT4 maximum | — |
| Manifold pressure maximum | — |
| Fuel pressure minimum | must persist 10 s; engine at or above 1,000 rpm |
| Fuel pressure maximum | must persist climb 10 s, cruise 30 s, descent 10 s; not checked during taxi, takeoff, landing |
| Bus voltage minimum | engine at or above 1,000 rpm |
| Bus voltage maximum | — |
| Oil pressure min (<3500 rpm) | must persist 5 s; engine at or above 1,000 rpm; never filterable |

*Bus voltage limits are not Operators Manual limits; they are a check for 12 V installations that the app includes because a charging fault shows there first.*
